overview: Newlyweds receive a build-it-yourself house as a wedding gift—and the house can, supposedly, be built in "one week". A rejected suitor secretly re-numbers packing crates, and the husband struggles to assemble the house according to this new 'arrangement' of its parts.
overview_en: Buster and Sybil exit a chapel as newlyweds. Among the gifts is a portable house you easily put together in one week
